nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Traffic volumes and video-derived vehicle positions from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao through a tunnel in Shandong, China.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: Available from the corresponding author upon request as stated in the Data Availability section.

nodes_source.source_quote: a large-scale experiment conducted in Minneapolis-Saint Paul found that when the ramp meters were turned off, freeway capacity decreased by 9%, travel time increased by 22%
nodes_source.description: Data from a large-scale experiment in Minneapolis-Saint Paul regarding freeway capacity and travel time when ramp meters were turned off.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: Cited reference [7] only, no direct link or acquisition path provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations from raw images are extracted to reconstruct visual representations in the DRL method
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle location points (xi, yi) from raw video frames to create position matrices mt. Includes zooming and down-sampling to a 4x512 pixel size.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, generic tools used but not named, key observation size parameter provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: we stack the matrices of consecutive N time steps to represent the state st
nodes_process.description: Stacks N consecutive position matrices to capture vehicle dynamics. N is set to 3 frames.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, stacking logic fully specified with parameter N=3.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based Q-network using multitask learning to predict Q-values, mean speed, and queue length. Uses experience replay and a target network for stability.
tools_mentioned: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU version not stated
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, optimizer named, and all key hyperparameters from Table 1 provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the trained model in a SUMO simulation of a real-world freeway segment (Qingdao-Huangdao tunnel). Compares against no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, simulator named, and specific road network parameters provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Divides the control area into eight subareas and removes information from specific subareas to test the impact on DRL performance.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, methodology for perturbation is described but specific removal technique is brief.
